roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This pivotal role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring our team is highly trained and our environment remains safe for all residents and staff. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of continuous learning and adherence to best practices.

We are seeking a proactive and knowledgeable Registered Nurse to champion our educational initiatives and uphold the highest standards of infection control. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care and staff competency within a supportive and professional setting. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour for this vital position.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or education within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care
Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills
